body:
Correction to my previous message: a shell quoting error ate a word in the one paragraph that mattered. It read "in a package that forces  to be explicit". The missing word is over -- the argument name.

The paragraph should read:

  STANDS  the one thing I would still like your view on whenever you resume, and it is the
          only open ask I have: plan_crossnobis() defaults metric = shrinkage_precision() at
          R/crossnobis.R:213. That is a silent statistical choice -- a shrinkage estimator
          selected for the user -- in a package that forces the OVER argument to be explicit
          on the grounds that partition independence is a claim about the user data. Those
          two positions look inconsistent to me. I cannot tell from outside whether the
          shrinkage default was deliberated or inherited, and it is the one item from this
          review that sits in your certification chain rather than in mine.

Nothing else in that message was affected.
